title: Sections
description: Per-section balances, low-balance alerts and activity (docs/features/sections.md)

panels.title: Critical firing
panels.description: Critical alerts firing now (all components). Details in the table and on Prometheus's Alerts page.

panels.title: Warnings firing
panels.description: Warning alerts firing now (all components).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every alert firing now, critical first. 'Firing for' counts from when the condition started (including the rule's wait time). History: the Alert log dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, subject) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"} * 3 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning"} * 2 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}), "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)"))

max by (alertname, severity, subject) ((time() - label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS_FOR_STATE, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)")) and on(alertname, severity, subject) label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Disabled
panels.description: Disabled sections (calls with their key are refused); archived sections are not listed

panels.title: Upfront empty
panels.description: Enabled sections whose upfront account is empty: new accounts and -x fail (alert SectionUpfrontEmpty)

panels.title: Upfront low
panels.description: Enabled sections below upfront_low_balance_eth (alert SectionUpfrontLow)

panels.title: Runs out within 7 days
panels.description: Sections whose upfront account lasts less than 7 more days at the last 7 days' spending (-x and new-account funding)

targets.expr: count((max by (section) (proxy_section_balance_eth{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*",role="upfront"}) / on(section) ((sum by (section) (increase(proxy_section_amount_eth_total{op=~"transfer_out|create_account",section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*"}[7d])) / 7) > 0)) < 7) or vector(0)

panels.title: SENDER01 (ETH)
panels.description: SENDER01's balance: it funds every top-up (alert Sender01Low)

panels.title: Collected (ETH)
panels.description: In all consumption and payment accounts: earned by the sections, not paid back yet

panels.title: Sections (one row per section; filter with Section and Search above)
Sections needing attention
panels.description: Only the sections with a problem now: EMPTY (upfront at 0: new accounts and -x fail), LOW (upfront below upfront_low_balance_eth), < 7 DAYS LEFT (at the last 7 days' spending). Top up on the chainlens Sections page. Empty table = all sections OK.

targets.expr: (max by (section) (proxy_section_balance_eth{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*",role="upfront",active="1"}) == 0 and on() (proxy_section_low_balance_eth > 0)) * 0 + 3 or (max by (section) (proxy_section_balance_eth{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*",role="upfront",active="1"}) < on() group_left() (proxy_section_low_balance_eth > 0)) * 0 + 2 or ((max by (section) (proxy_section_balance_eth{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*",role="upfront"}) / on(section) ((sum by (section) (increase(proxy_section_amount_eth_total{op=~"transfer_out|create_account",section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*"}[7d])) / 7) > 0)) < 7) * 0 + 1

panels.title: All sections
panels.description: Every section: balances now (ETH), days the upfront account lasts at the last 7 days' spending (-x and new-account funding), and the activity of the last $period. Sorted by upfront (lowest first); click a title to sort, the funnel to filter; pages at the bottom.

targets.expr: (max by (section) (proxy_section_balance_eth{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*",role="upfront",active="1"}) == 0 and on() (proxy_section_low_balance_eth > 0)) * 0 + 3 or (max by (section) (proxy_section_balance_eth{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*",role="upfront",active="1"}) < on() group_left() (proxy_section_low_balance_eth > 0)) * 0 + 2 or ((max by (section) (proxy_section_balance_eth{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*",role="upfront"}) / on(section) ((sum by (section) (increase(proxy_section_amount_eth_total{op=~"transfer_out|create_account",section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*"}[7d])) / 7) > 0)) < 7) * 0 + 1 or max by (section) (proxy_section_active{section=~"$section",section=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) * 0
